about_the_game:
• Subsequent adjustments are still ongoing, with all random treasure chests adjusted and many additional skills added. The store has also made adjustments to all items

    • The subsequent content will differ greatly from the demo version.

The trial version showcases some content, and the game itself is a traditional JRPG game, with a focus on balancing the plot and battles.

Many JRPG games have long and boring plotlines that are not attractive, but in fact, if the plot is well done, it can be very interesting. The plot of this game takes a lot of thought and is not dragging on. Players will directly face difficulties and conflicts, with a strong sense of immersion.

Many games are either too simple and boring, or too difficult, which makes it difficult to have fun. People always oscillate between boredom and pain. If they are too simple, they will be bored, and if they are too difficult, they will be painful.

The key to this game is to balance this relationship

Players may feel pressure in battles, but due to their own efforts and preparing more supplies and medicinal herbs, they can still overcome it in the end,

There is no need to test players' reactions here, only their patience and luck. It belongs to a casual game that is difficult but can be completely overcome.

And occasionally, random equipment will be revealed, which will be full of surprises and expectations, making both the plot and battles full of anticipation.

Combined with the exploration of the Box Court map and more, it creates a simple, relaxed, and exciting experience.

The trial version only presents a portion of the content, allowing players to experience the fun and essence of the game. There will be many more contents that will appear in the full version in the future.

And the full version will also have more tasks and props, as well as side storylines.

The trial version currently only supports Chinese, and we plan to try the English version in the future. Currently, the game only supports mouse and keyboard, and only the PC version is available.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4340 or better
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphic board that works with OpenGL 4.4 or higher
  • Storage: 8 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 11 sound device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Core i5-8400 / Ryzen 5 1500X or better
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce™ GTX1650 AMD Radeon™ RX570

short_description: In a forgotten ancient world, this JRPG blends turn-based combat with novel-like storytelling, delivering thrilling adventures through mysteries and challenges. ﻿
